final_assessment: Post-archive architect session for rc04a-judgement-record. COMPLETION RATIFIED (Sal, 2026-09-21) — the program's fourth complete stage. R-crc-12 CAPTURED: a criterion written before the test cannot grade the test; when a stage's shipped mechanism invalidates its own exit criterion's terms the stage revises the criterion and records why, with the boundary stated so the ruling cannot be abused — a criterion the mechanism can still measure and does not meet is a MISS. Two instances produced it (rc07's exit ratified as a miss; rc04a's exit (3) revised THREE to TWO with its derivation). Q-crc-21 OPENED: the Touchpoints parser anchors LIST_ITEM to a line where orbit-propose-modifications defines an entry as a markdown list item, so a wrapped +-joined group silently loses its continuation members and does not report them malformed — observed live on rc04a's own design.md, and the third instance of one class (with Q-crc-15's fence grammars and rc07's retired inline-code scanner). Its standing recommendation is to fold it into Q-crc-15's stage rather than charter a fourth, because the class rather than the instance is the right unit of work. Four residues routed here by rc04a's task 6.4 are repaired in the doc's forward-looking prose: exit (3)'s count with its reason, the ONE-COMPUTED-RULE claim qualified to name what it is a rule ABOUT, the rc04 parent's boundary-with-rc02c paragraph (it described a relationship with the clause-(c) predicate rc02c DELETED, so the boundary has had one side since 2026-09-21), and the residual_risk field name in the one forward-looking place it still steered something. The other four residual_risk occurrences sit in the status log and in resolved-question records and are deliberately left: a ledger rewritten to match what later happened stops being evidence. rc04c's charter now carries the NAMED HOLE in its own strict-subset premise, inherited rather than left to discover. CLAUDE.md corrected on two counts the pre-archive audit found: it called Q-crc-16 live where this doc records it RESOLVED 2026-09-20, and its inline ruling enumeration had stopped at R-crc-10 — both now fixed, with the paragraph relabelled so it no longer reads as the program's full live set. The marked ruling count ripples 11 to 12 and orbit validate --sources is clean at 25.
